integrity: The complete factor-cover hitting system is built independently in two ways. Every three-position set is excluded, every four-position set is exhausted, and an independent recursive transversal engine reproduces exactly the same 32 attractors and the two closed-form families.
scientific_limitations: The result completely classifies smallest attractors only for the canonical length-64 Thue--Morse prefix t_6. It does not assert stabilization or a formula for all larger prefixes. Unindexed computations could contain the same census.
title: The 64-letter Thue--Morse word has exactly 32 smallest string attractors
